MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How does the voice move in the second tone? (1 mark)
   A. It falls sharply
   B. It stays flat
   C. It rises
   D. It dips and rises

2. Which of these is the first tone mark? (1 mark)
   A. A falling line, as in à
   B. A small V, as in ǎ
   C. A rising line, as in á
   D. A flat line, as in ā

3. Which Chinese word means "mother"? (1 mark)
   A. 谁 shéi
   B. 妹妹 mèimei
   C. 妈妈 māma
   D. 那 nà

4. What does 那是我哥哥 nà shì wǒ gēge mean? (1 mark)
   A. That is my older brother
   B. That is my mother
   C. This is my younger brother
   D. This is my sister

5. Read the pinyin: yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The television is in the living room.
   B. The chair is under the table.
   C. There is a bed in the bedroom.
   D. The door is on the left.

6. Fill the blank: 电视在____? (Where is the television?) (1 mark)
   A. 哪儿
   B. 谁
   C. 几
   D. 什么

7. In the Swahili week, which day is counted as day 1? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Monday
   C. Sunday
   D. Friday

8. What does 昨天 zuótiān mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yesterday
   B. Tomorrow
   C. Today
   D. Morning

9. What does 星期二 (xīngqī'èr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Nine
   C. School
   D. Tuesday

10. What does 蜡烛 (làzhú) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Candle
   B. Birthday
   C. Month
   D. To come

11. Which Chinese word means "which number, how many"? (1 mark)
   A. 朋友 péngyou
   B. 送 sòng
   C. 唱歌 chànggē
   D. 几 jǐ

12. Which Chinese word means "what"? (1 mark)
   A. 水 shuǐ
   B. 什么 shénme
   C. 葡萄 pútao
   D. 肉 ròu

13. Which verb goes with 米饭? (1 mark)
   A. 来
   B. 看
   C. 喝
   D. 吃

14. What does 手 (shǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Head
   B. Hand
   C. Foot
   D. Shoulder

15. What does 耳朵 (ěrduo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tooth
   B. Shoulder
   C. Knee
   D. Ear

16. What does 风 (fēng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Flood
   B. Cloud
   C. Not
   D. Wind

17. Which sentence means "The wind is very strong."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是太阳。
   B. 今天天气很好。
   C. 太阳很大。
   D. 风很大。

18. What does 大 (dà) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Big
   B. Drought
   C. It rains
   D. Snow

19. What does 上面 (shàngmiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Above
   B. Garden
   C. Bathroom
   D. Door

20. What does 旁边 (pángbiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fridge
   B. Beside
   C. Table
   D. House

21. What does 叫 (jiào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. To be called
   C. Hello (polite)
   D. Hello

22. What does 是 (shì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Older sister
   B. Is, am, are
   C. Daughter
   D. Love

23. What does 爱 (ài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Love
   B. Is, am, are
   C. Younger brother
   D. Mother

24. Why should you not shout when reading aloud? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting makes tones clearer
   B. Shouting spoils the tones and hurts the throat
   C. Shouting is polite
   D. Shouting is quiet

25. Which character is the number five? (1 mark)
   A. 七
   B. 五
   C. 九
   D. 三

26. What does 两 liǎng mean in 两只眼睛? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Big
   C. Two
   D. One

27. What does 小 (xiǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sun
   B. Small
   C. It rains
   D. Not

28. How long is the pause at a full stop compared with a comma? (1 mark)
   A. Longer
   B. Shorter
   C. The same
   D. There is no pause

29. Read the pinyin: fēng hěn dà. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sun is very big.
   B. The wind is very strong.
   C. Today it rains.
   D. Today there are clouds.

30. Fill the blank: 我家有五____人。 (There are five people in my family.) (1 mark)
   A. 两
   B. 号
   C. 只
   D. 口

31. Which sentence is correct for "The chair is under the table"? (1 mark)
   A. 在椅子桌子下。
   B. 椅子下在桌子。
   C. 桌子在椅子下。
   D. 椅子在桌子下。

32. Read the pinyin: diànshì zài kètīng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The door is on the left.
   B. The bed is in the bedroom.
   C. The television is in the living room.
   D. The garden is on the right of the house.

33. What does 今天 (jīntiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tomorrow
   B. School
   C. Today
   D. Mosque

34. What does 礼物 (lǐwù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Gift
   B. We
   C. To play
   D. Knife

35. Which sentence means "We cut the cake."? (1 mark)
   A. 祝你生日快乐!
   B. 你生日是几月几号?
   C. 我们唱歌。
   D. 我们切蛋糕。

36. Which two characters share 肉? (1 mark)
   A. 米饭 and 蛋糕
   B. 牛肉 and 鸡肉
   C. 茶 and 咖啡
   D. 水 and 牛奶

37. What does 肩膀 (jiānbǎng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tooth
   B. Shoulder
   C. To look, to see
   D. To speak

38. What does 刷牙 (shuāyá) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Ear
   B. Foot
   C. To use
   D. To brush teeth

39. What does 没有 méiyǒu mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today
   B. There is not
   C. Very
   D. Also

40. Which sentence means "Today it rains."? (1 mark)
   A. 今天天气很好。
   B. 这是太阳。
   C. 今天下雨。
   D. 风很小。

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write three birthday activities in Chinese or English. (3 marks)

42. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 送 and 床. (2 marks)

43. Give three steps of good imitation when learning a new word. (3 marks)

44. Give three ways to make a reading club work well. (3 marks)

45. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 风 and 鸡肉. (2 marks)

46. Give two things to put in a reading journal. (2 marks)

47. Explain the sentence pattern for saying where something is, with an example. (3 marks)

48. Give three things to do when planning a showcase item. (3 marks)

49. Write these position words in Chinese with pinyin: beside, above and below. (3 marks)

50. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: nà shì wǒ dìdi. (2 marks)

51. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see." and "I use my ears to hear." (4 marks)

52. Write a five-sentence weather diary for one week in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

53. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Wednesday I go to school." (3 marks)

54. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sun is very big." (2 marks)

55. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My birthday is on 5 March." (3 marks)

56. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom." and "The television is on the table." (4 marks)

57. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my father." (2 marks)

58. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: zhè shì xiāngjiāo. (2 marks)

59. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 听 and 雨. (2 marks)

60. Write the difference between a statement and a question when reading aloud, with an example. (3 marks)

61. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my older sister." and "Who is this?" (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — It rises
   The second tone rises, like asking "What?"

2. D — A flat line, as in ā
   The first tone is high and level, so its mark is a flat line.

3. C — 妈妈 māma
   妈妈 (māma) means mother.

4. A — That is my older brother
   那 is that and 哥哥 is older brother.

5. B — The chair is under the table.
   yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià. is 椅子在桌子下。, which means "The chair is under the table.".

6. A — 哪儿
   哪儿 asks where.

7. A — Saturday
   Jumamosi, Saturday, is day one, so Monday is day three (Jumatatu).

8. A — Yesterday
   昨天 is yesterday.

9. D — Tuesday
   星期二 (xīngqī'èr) means Tuesday.

10. A — Candle
   蜡烛 (làzhú) means candle.

11. D — 几 jǐ
   几 (jǐ) means which number, how many.

12. B — 什么 shénme
   什么 (shénme) means what.

13. D — 吃
   We eat rice, so we use 吃.

14. B — Hand
   手 (shǒu) means hand.

15. D — Ear
   耳朵 (ěrduo) means ear.

16. D — Wind
   风 (fēng) means wind.

17. D — 风很大。
   风很大。 (fēng hěn dà.) means "The wind is very strong.".

18. A — Big
   大 (dà) means big.

19. A — Above
   上面 (shàngmiàn) means above.

20. B — Beside
   旁边 (pángbiān) means beside.

21. B — To be called
   叫 (jiào) means to be called.

22. B — Is, am, are
   是 (shì) means is, am, are.

23. A — Love
   爱 (ài) means love.

24. B — Shouting spoils the tones and hurts the throat
   Use projection, not shouting.

25. B — 五
   五 wǔ is five.

26. C — Two
   两 is two when counting things.

27. B — Small
   小 (xiǎo) means small.

28. A — Longer
   A full stop needs a longer pause.

29. B — The wind is very strong.
   fēng hěn dà. is 风很大。, which means "The wind is very strong.".

30. D — 口
   口 is used to count family members.

31. D — 椅子在桌子下。
   thing + 在 + place + 下.

32. C — The television is in the living room.
   diànshì zài kètīng. is 电视在客厅。, which means "The television is in the living room.".

33. C — Today
   今天 (jīntiān) means today.

34. A — Gift
   礼物 (lǐwù) means gift.

35. D — 我们切蛋糕。
   我们切蛋糕。 (wǒmen qiē dàngāo.) means "We cut the cake.".

36. B — 牛肉 and 鸡肉
   牛肉 is beef and 鸡肉 is chicken.

37. B — Shoulder
   肩膀 (jiānbǎng) means shoulder.

38. D — To brush teeth
   刷牙 (shuāyá) means to brush teeth.

39. B — There is not
   没有 is the opposite of 有.

40. C — 今天下雨。
   今天下雨。 (jīntiān xià yǔ.) means "Today it rains.".

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: 切蛋糕 (cut the cake), 送礼物 (give gifts), 唱歌 (sing), 和朋友一起玩 (play with friends). Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 送: sòng, to give (a gift). 床: chuáng, bed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the whole word, repeat it slowly, compare with the speaker and correct.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Be kind and do not laugh at mistakes, listen while others read, take turns fairly and help others who find reading hard.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风: fēng, wind. 鸡肉: jīròu, chicken (meat).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: New words with pinyin and meaning, sentences you can read well, or a recording of yourself reading.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Thing + 在 + place, with 上 or 下 at the end when needed. For example 电视在桌子上。
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for the example, 1 mark for the translation.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose an item, decide who does what, list the materials and words needed, practise several times.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: 旁边 pángbiān, 上面 shàngmiàn, 下面 xiàmiàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: That is my younger brother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

52. (5 marks)
   Answer: 星期一,太阳很大。星期二,有云。星期三,下雨。星期四,风很大。星期五,太阳很大。 xīngqīyī, tàiyáng hěn dà. xīngqī'èr, yǒu yún. xīngqīsān, xià yǔ. xīngqīsì, fēng hěn dà. xīngqīwǔ, tàiyáng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each day with weather and pinyin.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: 太阳很大。 tàiyáng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我的生日是三月五号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì. 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is a banana.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: 听: tīng, to listen, to hear. 雨: yǔ, rain.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: A statement ends a little lower, like 电视在客厅。 A question ends a little higher, like 电视在哪儿? Every syllable keeps its tone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each and 1 mark for keeping the tones.

61. (4 marks)
   Answer: 这是我姐姐。 zhè shì wǒ jiějie. 这是谁? zhè shì shéi?
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.
